method: Each ground-truth feature (gt_j1.json: 2023 Adams County building outline bbox centre of a surviving building, or Warren GCP with modern ground truth) was located by eye in 4x-4.5x crops (gtmont.py) centred on the position predicted by the chain of record plus a coarse shift, tick grid 20 px; px = predicted + shift + read offset. Reading precision about 5 px (building symbols are schematic squares 8-20 px wide).

SCHMUCKER block 157 px south is the alternative; relative to the Chambersburg Pike the 367 m GT distance favours the southern block); not used
